defects.statement: The ten-cell midpoint ratio does not resolve the narrow peak and biases the efficiency; a converged quadrature changes the reported cross section.
The transformation of a density specified with respect to dm requires the Jacobian 1/(2*sqrt(t)); canceling a common cell width does not cancel this varying factor.
